description: This file defines the Theme class responsible for writing theme data into an XLSX file in XML format. It includes methods to serialize theme elements such as color schemes, font schemes, and other style components, utilizing an XMLWriter. The class extends a base WriterPart class and interacts with the Spreadsheet object to extract theme details.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Class responsible for serializing spreadsheet theme data into XML format for XLSX files.

methods.name: writeTheme
methods.description: Serializes the theme data from a Spreadsheet object into XML format, writing various style components including color schemes, font schemes, fill styles, line styles, and effects.

methods.name: writeFonts
methods.description: Helper method that writes font information (Latin, East Asian, Complex Script, and substitutions) into XML elements.

methods.name: writeColourScheme
methods.description: Helper method that writes the color scheme details into XML, including system colors and RGB colors based on the theme's color array.
